paragraphs.source_en: Retirement doesn’t mean you stop working. It means you can stop working *for money*. We all want to be useful, to be recognized by others for the contribution we make. If we think paid employment is our only admirable, respectable, and consequential way to contribute, then who’d want to retire? Nobody wants to be a has-been, washed up, put out to pasture. Disconnecting work from wages means that you are valuable in every role, task, activity—and it might free you to retire a lot earlier so you can give a lot more of yourself to others.
